以下仅基于输入条目，已排除数字健康、生命科学与药物相关内容；引用编号对应输入条目。

一、研究进展
- 胸片机会性评估骨质疏松性骨折风险：开发队列53,109人，外部验证85,284人来自两家独立机构；以常规胸片构建CNN生存模型预测新发主要骨质疏松性骨折，用C-index与AUROC评估；入组要求胸片与双能X线吸收法检查间隔1年内，均属被转诊人群[2]。
- 结直肠癌CT影像组学与多模态评估：回顾性纳入两中心879例，中心A训练、中心B独立测试；临床-影像组学列线图良恶性分类测试AUC 0.957；3年与5年总生存影像组学测试AUC 0.874/0.898[4]。
- 肺癌影像AI统计方法学元研究：纳入2023至2025年36项肺癌影像AI研究，75%使用卷积神经网络，81%以AUC为主要评价指标[6]。
- 虚拟房颤动力学：基于323例患者高密度电解剖图重建左房数字孪生，计算节点恢复斜率；四种恢复模式可分层导管消融后临床复发风险；虚拟房颤非持续者复发风险独立更低[7]。
- AI-INFOCARE随机对照试验：单中心纳入300例神经外科门诊成人，1:1随机；干预为经质量核查的AI生成通俗版病情摘要；主要终点为患者报告医患互动质量FAPI[8]。
- AI增强听诊识别左心室功能不全：在四个标准听诊部位采集心音并同步单导联心电，以超声LVEF≤40%定义左心室功能不全；采用transformer与一维CNN集成模型并外部验证[9]。
- AI-PDCA双链式思维框架：构建双CoT大模型驱动的PDCA问诊训练框架，对135名医学生教育数据做回顾性观察分析，以教师评分为参照评估AI评分可靠性[11]。
- Tele-Cranio远程AI无CT诊疗：用手机2D面部照片重建3D面部与骨性形态，支持基于术者骨性方案的术后模拟；建模数据含539例配对样本、334例患者[13]。
- 心电图基础模型用于年轻竞技运动员筛查：在8.7万条心电上微调三个心电基础模型，仅用43例专家标注运动员心电测试；PhysioNet测试AUROC 0.97，运动员数据明显下降，ECGFounder表现最佳AUROC 0.84[14]。
- 脑连接组与临床文本对齐的轻度认知障碍框架：以脑子网络为token而非原始图像块，在个体与连接组层面跨模态对齐，强调影像与文本关联的可解释性[16]。
- MedReShaper眶骨折重建：采用基于网格的AI方法用于眶骨折重建中的三维解剖形状补全，并完成受控技术验证[18]。
- LLM生成出院摘要临床接受度：JAMA Network Open发表5家伦敦医院2022-2023年入院记录回顾性研究，以非劣效框架比较LLM与医生撰写出院摘要的临床接受度[20]。
- 宫腔镜AI落地综述：叙述性综述梳理语音听写、环境记录、决策支持与手术室调度等环节，以宫腔镜区分图像级与患者级证据，并采用区分内部与独立验证的评估框架[41]。
- 肺部疾病AI综述：覆盖肺癌、COPD、哮喘、结核、间质性肺病及COVID-19等筛查、诊断、治疗与预后；属综述性章节，无原始数据[42]。
- 临床AI时代医学教育观点：AI延伸临床推理，掌握重心转向调度、监督与对智能系统适度信任；教学重点从背事实转为质疑机器推理、识别失效模式[43]。
- 颅缝早闭手术规划AI范围综述：纳入11项儿科研究，方法含无监督学习、CNN、有限元模型、VAE；应用覆盖严重度评分、表型分类、术前模拟与预后预测；AI指标与专家评估高度相关[47]。

二、落地监管
- 欧盟医疗器械法规改革提案：2025年12月欧委会提出关键法规修订，目标含消除双重监管、减少文档要求；评论文章认为改革总体方向合理，但未解决AI器械面临的特定挑战[12]。
- FDA临床决策支持指南评述：评述FDA 2026年1月CDS指南，指出AI赋能的CDS可能加剧临床医生自动化偏差；AI生成或转换信息难以在常规诊疗中核验；作者提出将务实触发条件纳入现有治理框架[15]。
- MHRA伦敦区域监管沙盒：英国MHRA就伦敦区域监管沙盒公开征集意向，面向AI医疗器械制造商与NHS医疗服务机构[37]。

三、产业动态
- OpenAI扩展医疗计算机操作智能体：合作方包括CVS Health、Cigna与Abridge，目标为自动处理电子病历与支付方门户等重复人工任务[30]。
- FDA批准GE HealthCare设备端AI：用于X线影像中饲养管置入位置判断[32]。

四、限制与待核实
- 预印本证据：InclusionMed提出开放医疗AI评测计划，首版覆盖9格中的3格，前沿大模型综合得分17.5–49.1/100；证据级别为预印本[26]。
- 预印本证据：System 1本地智能体在1952条生物医学工具请求上达97.0%正确率，未出现编造内容，优于18种本地LLM配置；证据级别为预印本[27]。
- 预印本证据：Decision2Care在546例急诊入院12种疾病上诊断准确率86.5%，对比MIRA-v2的86.1%，中位耗时2.2秒、基线92–100秒；证据级别为预印本[40]。
- 预印本证据：EHRDiB在MIMIC-IV与Duke Health上对比11种方法，8项补全中7项与真实数据分类器差距最小，合成任务AUPRC差距缩小45.2%，并评估泄露风险；证据级别为预印本[38]。
- 预印本方法学：Sepsis-3标签研究固定MIMIC-III 13,388例、eICU 94,782例首住ICU，在五个预处理域构造51种设置，比较各设置下检出率差异；证据级别为预印本[35]。
- 预印本方法学：30天再入院预测审计基于MIMIC-IV约236,906次Medicare保险住院，患病率21.4%，历史特征按原始时间戳重算并剔除全病程特征，仅内部验证；证据级别为预印本[36]。
- 题录信息不足：以下条目输入未提供摘要、性能或验证细节，需核实——脓毒症预测AI/ML工具仅见标题[10]；SurgPace仅标题与作者[19]；LifespanFix仅题录[31]；罕见病持续诊断仅题录且无摘要[34]；有序共形部分标签预测仅标题与卷期[46]。
- 未招募试验：AI-ECG筛查早期心衰集群随机试验计划入组5400人，尚未招募、无结果[25]；结核AI辅助皮肤试验三国干预试验计划1804人，刚注册、尚未招募、无结果[48]；微创上尿路手术AI解剖识别观察性试验计划1700例，尚未招募、无结果，申办方为解放军总医院[49]。
- 外部验证与样本限制：ECG基础模型运动员外部测试仅43例[14]；AI-INFOCARE为单中心300例[8]；结直肠癌影像组学为回顾性两中心879例[4]；胸片骨质疏松研究的开发与验证均属被转诊人群，且胸片与DXA检查间隔1年内[2]。

items.title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
items.zh_title: OpenScientist：开源智能体AI协科学家用于临床与生物医学发现
items.summary: 开源智能体AI协科学家OpenScientist可针对科学家提出的问题生成可验证、有数据支撑的分析，并在五个生物医学案例中由领域专家评估。
key_points: 开源智能体系统，输出可验证、数据可溯源的分析
五个生物医学案例由领域专家评估
数分钟完成原需数月人力的分析
含隐藏评估队列与外部队列验证的案例
items.reason: 开源智能体系统+领域专家多案例评估，含隐藏与外部队列，属重要档
items.abstract: Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.
items.zh_abstract: 生物医学研究受到分析日益庞大和复杂数据集所需时间和领域专业知识的制约。在此，我们介绍 OpenScientist，一种开源智能体式 AI 协同科学家，旨在通过研究科学家定义的查询并生成可验证、以数据为基础的分析来弥合这一差距。OpenScientist 由领域专家在五项生物医学案例研究中进行了评估，可在数分钟内完成原本需要数月人工时间和专业知识才能完成的分析。它准确量化了阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer’s）血液生物标志物的性能，生成了一个血浆蛋白质组学生存模型，该模型在隐藏评估队列中预测了生存，提出了一个将 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变联系起来、可重复的机制，生成了多发性骨髓瘤假设并在外部队列中得到验证，且在随机对照中信号减弱，并在一项盲法、预先设定的蛋白质组学比较中显示出与独立人工分析的一致性。这些结果支持使用 OpenScientist 与人类专家协同辅助生物医学数据分析。为支持涉及敏感临床数据集的研究，OpenScientist 可在使用开源模型进行推理的完全气隙隔离环境中运行。OpenScientist 表明，开放、可审计的智能体式 AI 可以通过检索文献、生成假设、执行分析并从复杂数据集中生成洞见来支持真实世界临床研究。

items.title: Opportunistic Risk Assessment of Major Osteoporotic Fractures from Routine Chest Radiographs Using Deep Learning
items.zh_title: 深度学习从常规胸片机会性评估骨质疏松性骨折风险
items.summary: 在5.3万例成人中开发卷积神经网络生存模型，用常规胸片预测主要骨质疏松性骨折，并在两家独立机构8.5万例中外部验证。
key_points: 开发队列53,109人，外部验证85,284人来自两家独立机构
以胸片影像构建CNN生存模型，主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折
用C-index与AUROC评估区分度，针对骨量减少区间风险识别盲区
入组要求胸片与双能X线吸收法检查间隔1年内，均属被转诊人群
items.reason: 大样本且两家独立机构外部验证，属重要档；回顾性设计、未报告临床结局改善故不上调
items.abstract: Background Bone mineral density (BMD) and the Fracture Risk Assessment Tool (FRAX) incompletely capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where much of the fracture burden occurs. Routine chest radiographs are acquired across a broad range of patients and may contain information relevant to fracture risk, offering a potential opportunistic complement without additional imaging burden. Methods We developed a convolutional neural network survival model in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated it in 85,284 patients from two independent institutions. Eligibility required a chest radiograph obtained within 1 year of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry scans, so all participants had been referred for densitometry. The primary outcome was incident major osteoporotic fracture. Discrimination was assessed by using the concordance index (C-index) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years, compared with FRAX with BMD and with the lowest BMD T-score. Results In the external validation cohorts (mean 58.6 years of age; 68.9% female; and follow-up of 77 months), the deep-learning (DL) model achieved a C-index of 0.843 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.837 to 0.850) and a censoring-adjusted 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.846 to 0.863), which was higher than that of FRAX with BMD (C-index, 0.779, 95% CI, 0.770 to 0.787; 10-year AUROC, 0.785, 95% CI, 0.775 to 0.794; both P Conclusions A survival DL model applied to routine chest radiographs identified patients at high fracture risk with discrimination exceeding that of FRAX, with the greatest benefit in patients with osteopenia. As all participants had been referred for densitometry, absolute-risk and case-finding estimates require prospective evaluation in an unselected routine-radiography population. (Funded by the National Research Foundation of Korea and others.).
items.zh_abstract: 【背景】骨密度（BMD）和骨折风险评估工具（FRAX）不能完全捕捉骨量减少范围内的骨折风险，而大部分骨折负担发生在该范围内。常规胸部X线片在广泛患者人群中获取，可能包含与骨折风险相关的信息，提供一种潜在的机会性补充，而不增加额外影像负担。【方法】我们在53,109名三级医院成人中开发了一种卷积神经网络生存模型，并在来自两个独立机构的85,284名患者中进行了外部验证。纳入资格要求胸部X线片在双能X线吸收测定扫描前1年内获取，因此所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定。主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折。通过使用一致性指数（C-index）以及2年、3年、5年和10年的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估判别能力，并与联合BMD的FRAX以及最低BMD T值进行比较。【结果】在外部验证队列中（平均年龄58.6岁；女性68.9%；随访77个月），深度学习（DL）模型达到C-index为0.843（95%置信区间[CI]，0.837至0.850）以及经删失校正的10年AUROC为0.855（95% CI，0.846至0.863），高于联合BMD的FRAX（C-index，0.779，95% CI，0.770至0.787；10年AUROC，0.785，95% CI，0.775至0.794；两者均P）【结论】应用于常规胸部X线片的生存DL模型识别出高骨折风险患者，其判别能力超过FRAX，在骨量减少患者中获益最大。由于所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定，绝对风险和病例发现估计需要在未选择的常规放射摄影人群中进行前瞻性评估。（由韩国国家研究基金会等资助。）

items.title: Multicenter evaluation of radiomics and multimodal artificial intelligence for colorectal cancer diagnosis and survival prediction
items.zh_title: 影像组学与多模态 AI 用于结直肠癌诊断与生存预测的多中心评估
items.summary: 回顾性纳入两中心 879 例，中心 A 训练、中心 B 独立测试，评估 CT 影像组学与多模态融合模型对良恶性分类及生存预测的表现。

临床-影像组学列线图良恶性分类测试 AUC 0.957

items.abstract: Reliable preoperative classification and outcome prediction could improve management of locally advanced colorectal cancer. We retrospectively studied 879 participants from two centers, including 741 patients with locally advanced colorectal cancer and 138 with benign colorectal lesions. Clinical, radiomics, deep learning, and early fusion models were trained at center A (n = 615) and independently tested at center B (n = 264) using pretreatment contrast-enhanced computed tomography and clinical data. The clinical-radiomics nomogram achieved a test AUC of 0.957 for benign-malignant classification. For 3-year and 5-year overall survival, radiomics achieved test AUCs of 0.874 and 0.898, while fusion achieved 0.870 and 0.899, respectively. These findings identify CT radiomics as a promising digital biomarker for colorectal cancer stratification and show that early deep learning fusion offers limited incremental value over an optimized radiomics baseline.
items.zh_abstract: 可靠的术前分类和结局预测可改善局部晚期结直肠癌的管理。我们回顾性研究了来自两个中心的879名参与者，包括741例局部晚期结直肠癌患者和138例良性结直肠病变患者。使用治疗前增强计算机断层扫描（CT）和临床数据，在A中心（n = 615）训练临床、影像组学、深度学习和早期融合模型，并在B中心（n = 264）进行独立测试。临床-影像组学列线图在良恶性分类中的测试AUC为0.957。对于3年和5年总生存期，影像组学的测试AUC分别为0.874和0.898，而融合模型分别为0.870和0.899。这些发现表明CT影像组学是一种有前景的用于结直肠癌分层的数字生物标志物，并显示与经过优化的影像组学基线相比，早期深度学习融合仅提供有限的增量价值。

items.title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories
items.zh_title: 可解释AI将痛风临床表型与多组学及健康轨迹关联
items.summary: 用常规实验室变量无监督分型，并在英国生物银行、中国GoutRe与MIMIC-IV三个队列外部评估。
key_points: 21,235人数据，含两个外部独立队列
识别三种痛风亚型，复发与死亡风险不同
C2亚型复发风险显著高于C1
items.reason: 跨三国多队列外部验证且样本过万，符合重要档加分项。
items.abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry (n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV (n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.

items.abstract: AbstractAI models using medical images are increasingly proposed to support clinical decision-making in lung cancer, motivating assessment of their methodological rigor and transparency. To assess how these models are developed, evaluated, and reported, and to identify gaps in best statistical practices, we conducted a cross-sectional meta-research review of OpenAlex-indexed studies (January 1, 2023, to June 30, 2025) that developed image-based AI tools for lung cancer risk prediction, detection, or prognosis. Thirty-six studies met our inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks were used in most studies (27 studies, 75%), and area under the curve (AUC) was the most frequently reported evaluation metric (29 studies, 81%). Although 23 studies (64%) reported some form of uncertainty quantification, most were limited to presenting confidence intervals for global performance metrics (e.g., AUC, sensitivity, and accuracy) rather than individual prediction- or risk-level uncertainty. Common limitations included limited external test set use (14 studies, 39%), insufficient subgroup analyses (10 studies, 28%), and limited adherence to established prediction-model reporting guidelines. Overall, future research should prioritize standardized reporting, use of external test sets, and model performance assessment across clinically relevant subpopulations. The coexistence of increasingly powerful AI-based prediction models with inconsistent study design, evaluation, and reporting practices emphasizes the urgent need to implement more rigorous and transparent methodological standards in this field. items.abstract: Chamber-wide assessment of restitution dynamics is not feasible in vivo during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. We reconstructed left-atrial digital twins from high-density (HD) bipolar electroanatomical maps in 323 patients, computed node-level restitution steepness (maximal restitution slope [Smax]; >0.4 million nodes), and induced virtual AF with standardized ramp pacing to classify sustainability (sustained ≥16 s vs non-sustained <16 s), excluding 32 cases with extensive low-voltage substrate and depressed mean Smax. We found that clustering of HD restitution profiles identifies four restitution patterns that stratify clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence, with the Overall-Low pattern (aHR, 0.37) and the Average-Homogeneous pattern (aHR, 0.59) each showing lower risk than the Overall-High pattern. Furthermore, non-sustained virtual AF independently predicted lower recurrence (aHR: 0.27). Adding restitution pattern and sustainability to clinical covariates improved discrimination (ΔHarrell’s C-index: 0.050), and the combined digital-twin model remained incremental after adjustment for low-voltage area burden, supporting digital-twin outputs as complementary functional descriptors for risk stratification after pulmonary vein isolation.

items.abstract: Background Limited health literacy, clinical jargon, and time-constrained consultations often impair patients' understanding of medical findings. We evaluated whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay language summaries provided before consultations improve communication-related outcomes. Methods In this single-center, randomized trial in an outpatient neurosurgical setting, 300 adults were randomly assigned 1:1 to standard care with or without a quality-checked, AI-generated layperson summary of their medical findings (Simply Onno) before consultation. The primary end point was patient-reported quality of physician-patient interaction (Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]). Secondary end points included autonomy support (Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]), encounter difficulty (Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]), and consultation duration (minutes). Results The mean FAPI score was higher in the intervention group (4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54; difference, 0.17; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.05 to 0.29; P=0.005; Hedges' g=0.33), driven by shared decision-making (difference, 0.29; 95% CI, 0.15 to 0.42), with no evidence of a difference in perceived empathy. Patient-rated autonomy support was higher (difference, 0.14; 95% CI, 0.06 to 0.23), whereas physicians rated their own autonomy support slightly lower (difference, -0.12; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.21 to -0.04). Median consultation time was 25 versus 33 minutes in the intervention group versus the control group, respectively, an approximate 21% relative reduction (ratio of geometric means, 0.79; 95% CI, 0.70 to 0.88). For encounter difficulty (DDPRQ-10), we found potential evidence of a small increase (difference, 0.09; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.03 to 0.21). Secondary end point confidence intervals were unadjusted for multiplicity. Conclusions AI-generated summaries provided before outpatient neurosurgical consultations were associated with better patient-reported interaction quality and autonomy support and shorter consultations. Physicians rated their own autonomy support as slightly lower in the intervention group; evidence for increased encounter difficulty was limited, with confidence intervals compatible with no difference. These findings support further evaluation of quality-checked, patient-facing document translation; effects on clinical outcomes and clinician workload require confirmation before routine adoption.

items.abstract: Background Left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) is common and associated with adverse prognosis, even in asymptomatic individuals. Early treatment improves outcomes, underscoring the need for efficient strategies to identify patients who may benefit from echocardiographic evaluation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an AI auscultation method to detect LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography. Methods In this prospective, multicenter study, adult patients referred for echocardiography were enrolled to undergo digital auscultation at four standard auscultation sites with simultaneous single-lead ECGs. LVD was defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than or equal to 40% on concurrent echocardiography. An ensemble model combining a transformer-based network and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was trained on multicenter data and externally validated. The model's performance was compared with a seven-cardiologist reader substudy and clinical logistic regression models incorporating clinical variables, single-lead ECG-derived features, and B-type natriuretic peptide levels. Results The multicenter training cohort included 2359 patients (mean age, 69.7±13.5 years; 40.4% female; 8.9% with reduced LVEF). The external validation cohort of 964 patients (mean age, 68.6±15.4 years; 38.9% female; 7.6% with reduced LVEF) was obtained from another independent multicenter registry. The four-site AI auscultation outperformed ECG-only models and the clinical logistic models, achieving an area under the receiver operator curve (AUROC) of 0.926 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.911 to 0.939) in the training cohort. In the external validation cohort, AUROC was 0.904 (95% CI, 0.876 to 0.930) and sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were 86.3%, 74.2%, and 75.1%, respectively. In a 100-patient reader substudy, AI auscultation outperformed cardiologist consensus in accuracy (82.0% vs. 62.0%; P=0.004). Model performance was consistent across prespecified subgroups. The simplified two-site auscultation model retained high accuracy in the external validation cohort (AUROC, 0.903; 95% CI, 0.878 to 0.927). Conclusions AI auscultation accurately detected LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography, supporting its potential as a scalable and accessible pre-echocardiographic risk-enrichment tool. Further validation is warranted before broader screening applications. (Funded by AMI Inc

items.abstract: Clinical history-taking and documentation are foundational competencies in undergraduate medical training, yet scalable and individualized training tools remain limited. Large language model (LLM)-based systems provide automated practice opportunities but often lack structured medical reasoning, closed-loop instructional design, and integration into formal curricula. As part of a curriculum reform initiative, we constructed a clinical case repository, developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated faculty Plan–Do–Check–Act (PDCA) training framework supported by dual chain-of-thought (CoT)-driven LLMs, and evaluated the reliability of AI-based scoring against faculty assessment. We then conducted a retrospective observational analysis of routinely collected educational performance data from 135 undergraduate medical students enrolled in one of three existing instructional configurations: traditional instruction, AI-assisted training, or AI + PDCA training. Educational outcomes were assessed using standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) assessments. The AI + PDCA configuration was associated with the highest OSCE performance in both history-taking and clinical documentation. Among the two AI-supported configurations, longitudinal mixed-effects modeling showed steeper learning trajectories in the AI + PDCA configuration than in the AI-assisted configuration. These findings suggest that integrating AI-derived learning analytics with faculty-guided instructional intervention may support a closed-loop educational model associated with favorable competency acquisition while maintaining human oversight. This framework offers a scalable approach for implementing trustworthy, competency-based AI-enhanced medical education in routine academic practice.
items.zh_abstract: 临床病史采集和病历记录是本科医学培训中的基础胜任力，但可扩展且个体化的培训工具仍然有限。基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统提供了自动化练习机会，但往往缺乏结构化的医学推理、闭环教学设计以及整合到正式课程中。作为课程改革举措的一部分，我们构建了一个临床病例库，开发了一个整合人工智能（AI）的教师 Plan–Do–Check–Act（PDCA）培训框架，并由双思维链（CoT）驱动的 LLM 支持，同时评估了 AI 评分相对于教师评估的可靠性。随后，我们对 135 名本科医学生常规收集的教育表现数据进行了回顾性观察性分析，这些学生分别接受三种现有教学配置之一：传统教学、AI 辅助培训或 AI + PDCA 培训。教育结局使用标准化客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）评估来评价。AI + PDCA 配置在病史采集和临床病历记录方面均与最高的 OSCE 表现相关。在两种 AI 支持的配置中，纵向混合效应模型显示，AI + PDCA 配置的学习轨迹比 AI 辅助配置更陡峭。这些发现表明，将 AI 衍生的学习分析与教师指导的教学干预相结合，可能支持一种与良好胜任力获得相关的闭环教育模式，同时保持人类监督。该框架为在日常学术实践中实施可信、基于胜任力的 AI 增强医学教育提供了一种可扩展的方法。

items.abstract: The European Medical Device Regulations have been criticized for imposing disproportionate barriers to innovation due to excessive regulatory requirements. In response, the European Commission proposed amendments to key regulations in December 2025. The reforms aim to eliminate double regulation, reduce documentation requirements, and introduce new regulatory tools. In this Comment, we argue that these changes are generally well-targeted but leave specific challenges for innovative artificial intelligence-enabled medical devices unresolved.

items.title: Tele-Cranio: a CT-free AI solution for remote diagnosis and planning of craniomaxillofacial deformities

支持基于术者骨性方案的术后模拟

items.abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is central to craniomaxillofacial (CMF) deformity care, yet dependence on in-hospital imaging constrains remote preoperative assessment and outcome visualization, and repeated imaging can increase radiation and access burdens, particularly for children. We developed Tele-Cranio, a telemedicine-oriented artificial intelligence framework that uses mobile-acquired 2D facial photographs to reconstruct 3D facial morphology, estimate corresponding skeletal morphology and support postoperative facial simulation conditioned on surgeon-defined skeletal plans. Tele-Cranio was developed using 539 paired multimodal samples comprising 2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans and CT-derived skeletal models from individuals aged 3–60 years, including 334 patients with CMF deformities across malocclusion, cleft lip with/without palate, hemifacial microsomia and rare anomalies. Its core model, the Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity, learns a shared anatomical representation linking facial soft tissue and skeletal structures across normal and pathological morphology. For remote assessment, Tele-Cranio converts facial photographs into 3D facial surfaces and then infers 3D patient-specific skeletal geometry. For simulation, it generates individualized 3D postoperative facial previews after clinicians complete skeletal planning using standard clinical tools. Validated across heterogeneous CMF subgroups, Tele-Cranio provides an interpretable CT-free layer for remote triage, pre-CT consultation, radiation-free follow-up and surgeon–patient communication, while complementing rather than replacing CT-based definitive diagnosis and operative planning.
items.zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）是颅颌面（CMF）畸形诊疗的核心，但依赖院内成像限制了远程术前评估和结果可视化，而且重复成像可能增加辐射和可及性负担，尤其是对儿童而言。我们开发了 Tele-Cranio，这是一种面向远程医疗的人工智能框架，利用移动设备采集的 2D 面部照片重建 3D 面部形态、估计相应的骨骼形态，并支持以外科医生定义的骨骼方案为条件的术后面部模拟。Tele-Cranio 使用 539 对配对多模态样本开发，这些样本包括来自 3–60 岁个体的 2D 面部照片、3D 面部扫描和 CT 衍生的骨骼模型，其中包含 334 例 CMF 畸形患者，涵盖错颌畸形、伴或不伴腭裂的唇裂、半侧颜面短小症和罕见异常。其核心模型 Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity 学习一种共享的解剖表征，将正常和病理形态下的面部软组织与骨骼结构联系起来。对于远程评估，Tele-Cranio 将面部照片转换为 3D 面部表面，然后推断患者特异性的 3D 骨骼几何结构。对于模拟，它在临床医生使用标准临床工具完成骨骼规划后，生成个体化的 3D 术后面部预览。在异质性 CMF 亚组中验证后，Tele-Cranio 为远程分诊、CT 前会诊、无辐射随访和外科医生–患者沟通提供了一个可解释的无 CT 层，同时补充而非替代基于 CT 的确定性诊断和手术规划。

items.title: ECG foundation models for cardiovascular screening in a cohort of young competitive athletes
items.zh_title: 心电图基础模型用于年轻竞技运动员心血管筛查

key_points: PhysioNet测试AUROC 0.97，运动员数据明显下降
ECGFounder表现最佳，AUROC 0.84

items.abstract: AI-powered cardiac screening could evolve sports medicine by boosting accuracy, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, with automated ECG interpretation based on foundation models becoming key for large-scale athlete screening. Before deployment, it is crucial to verify whether these clinically developed models are applicable to this population. We evaluated whether ECG foundation models trained on general clinical populations can diagnose athlete-specific ECG findings. We fine-tuned three models (ECG-FM, HuBERT-ECG, ECGFounder) on PhysioNet/CinC 2021, 87,662 samples, and tested them on 43 expert-annotated ECGs from highly trained/national-level athletes. Performance was strong on PhysioNet/CinC 2021 (AUROC 0.97, AUPRC 0.57, Sensitivity 0.89) but dropped on athletes’ data, confirming domain shift. ECGFounder performed best (AUROC 0.84, AUPRC 0.72, Sensitivity 0.57) and detected the most frequent findings, Sinus Bradycardia (AUROC 0.87) and Sinus Arrhythmia (AUROC 0.95), well. Per-label estimates for rare classes must be interpreted cautiously, given the small cohort. This work contributes to developing athlete-focused AI frameworks for reliable ECG-based screening.
items.zh_abstract: 人工智能驱动的心脏筛查可能通过提高准确性、效率和成本效益来推动运动医学发展，而基于基础模型的自动化心电图解读正成为大规模运动员筛查的关键。部署前，必须验证这些临床开发的模型是否适用于该人群。我们评估了在一般临床人群上训练的心电图基础模型能否诊断运动员特有的心电图发现。我们在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021（87,662 个样本）上微调了三个模型（ECG-FM、HuBERT-ECG、ECGFounder），并在来自高度训练/国家级运动员的 43 份经专家标注的心电图上测试它们。在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 上表现强劲（AUROC 0.97、AUPRC 0.57、敏感性 0.89），但在运动员数据上下降，证实了域偏移。ECGFounder 表现最佳（AUROC 0.84、AUPRC 0.72、敏感性 0.57），并良好检测出最常见发现：窦性心动过缓（Sinus Bradycardia）（AUROC 0.87）和窦性心律不齐（Sinus Arrhythmia）（AUROC 0.95）。鉴于队列较小，对罕见类别的逐标签估计必须谨慎解读。这项工作有助于开发以运动员为中心的人工智能框架，用于可靠的心电图筛查。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled clinical decision support (CDS) challenges core assumptions of the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) recently updated CDS guidance, including the concepts of independent clinician review of outputs and manufacturer-intended use for exempting certain CDS tools from medical device regulation. We examine the FDA's January 2026 CDS guidance in the context of the evolving landscape of AI-enabled CDS tools, clinician interaction studies with AI-enabled CDS, and AI governance frameworks. Although the FDA's framework distinguishes non-device CDS from regulated software, AI-enabled CDS may synthesize and transform clinical information in ways that are difficult to verify during routine care, increasing clinician susceptibility to automation bias. Incorporating pragmatic triggers into existing governance frameworks can help identify scenarios with a heightened risk for clinical decision influence. Oversight calibrated to real-world clinical decision influence is needed to strengthen practical safety standards for AI-enabled CDS.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 人工智能（AI）赋能的临床决策支持（CDS）对食品药品监督管理局（FDA）最近更新的CDS指南的核心假设提出挑战，包括对输出进行独立临床医生审查的概念，以及制造商预期用途可使某些CDS工具豁免医疗器械监管的概念。我们在AI赋能CDS工具不断演变的格局、临床医生与AI赋能CDS交互研究以及AI治理框架的背景下，审视FDA 2026年1月的CDS指南。尽管FDA的框架将非器械CDS与受监管软件区分开来，但AI赋能CDS可能以在常规诊疗中难以核实的方式综合和转换临床信息，增加临床医生对自动化偏倚的易感性。将务实触发因素纳入现有治理框架，有助于识别临床决策影响风险升高的情景。需要根据现实世界临床决策影响进行校准的监督，以加强AI赋能CDS的实用安全标准。

items.source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
items.zh_title: 脑连接组与临床文本对齐的多模态轻度认知障碍框架
items.summary: IEEE TMI 论文提出将脑连接组与临床报告在共享跨模态隐空间对齐的多模态框架，用于轻度认知障碍研究。
key_points: 以脑子网络为 token 而非原始图像块

items.abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Integrating brain imaging data with clinical reports enables the effective use of complementary multimodal information, supporting more accurate and timely diagnosis in real-world clinical settings. This approach has gained growing attention in brain disorder research, yet significant limitations remain: how to encode brain structure and function to reflect meaningful neurological patterns, and how to effectively link objective imaging data with subjective text-based reports while establishing interpretable associations. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal framework that aligns brain connectomes with clinical reports in a shared cross-modal latent space at both subject and connectome levels. Our key innovation lies in treating brain subnetworks as tokens rather than raw image patches, enabling more efficient identification of system-level associations between neuroimaging findings and clinical observations. These cross-modal associations are further fused to enhance mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prediction and provide interpretable diagnostic insights. To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to integrate both structural and functional brain connectivity with non-imaging clinical information. Experimental validation on the ADNI dataset demonstrates performance competitive with recently reported methods. Notably, despite no explicit connectome-token-level supervision, the learned connectome-text associations recover multiple relationships independently reported in the neuroimaging and clinical literature, suggesting that the framework captures clinically coherent cross-modal associations. This pioneering work advances multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis by bridging the gap between neuroimaging analysis and clinical text interpretation through innovative connectome tokenization and cross-modal alignment strategies.
items.zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 将脑影像数据与临床报告相结合，能够有效利用互补的多模态信息，从而支持在真实临床环境中实现更准确、更及时的诊断。这种方法在脑部疾病研究中日益受到关注，但仍存在显著局限：如何编码脑结构与功能以反映有意义的神经学模式，以及如何有效将客观影像数据与主观文本报告联系起来，同时建立可解释的关联。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新的多模态框架，在受试者水平和连接组水平上，将脑连接组与临床报告在共享的跨模态潜空间中对齐。我们的关键创新在于将脑子网络视为 token（标记），而不是原始图像块，从而能够更高效地识别神经影像发现与临床观察之间的系统级关联。这些跨模态关联进一步被融合，以增强轻度认知障碍（MCI）预测并提供可解释的诊断见解。据我们所知，这是首次尝试将结构性和功能性脑连接与非影像临床信息整合起来。在 ADNI 数据集上的实验验证表明，其性能与近期报道的方法具有竞争力。值得注意的是，尽管没有明确的连接组 token 级监督，所学习到的连接组-文本关联恢复了神经影像和临床文献中独立报道的多重关系，这表明该框架捕捉到了临床一致的跨模态关联。这项开创性工作通过创新的连接组 token 化（tokenization）和跨模态对齐策略，弥合了神经影像分析与临床文本解读之间的差距，从而推进了用于神经退行性疾病诊断的多模态人工智能（AI）。

items.abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.
items.zh_abstract: 电子鼻（eNose）技术通过呼出气分析为疾病筛查提供了一种便携、非侵入性的途径。然而，该领域的进展受到阻碍，因为缺乏在现实条件下比较机器学习方法的系统性基准，尤其是传感器漂移——一种已知但很少被量化的失效模式。大多数现有研究依赖小型私有数据集且方案不一致，导致结果不可比较并减缓进展。我们推出 Breath-Dx，这是首个用于基于呼吸的疾病筛查的时间序列分类方法的综合基准。我们的工作利用 Scent of Health（S-OH）数据集，这是迄今最大的公开临床 eNose 集合，包含九个诊断组的 1,234 名患者，每位患者提供 17 通道多变量时间序列，并具有考虑传感器漂移的显式时间训练/测试划分。我们系统评估 10 种方法，涵盖四个类别：基于特征的表格学习器、基于卷积的模型、基于图的方法和时间序列架构。所有方法在时间验证下均显著退化（与随机交叉验证相比 AUC 下降 0.05-0.12），证实漂移嵌入了强时间信号。在这种现实评估下，最佳方法对某些肺部疾病达到 ROC AUC 0.74-0.76，而其他疾病仍接近随机水平。循环架构在跨疾病中表现最一致，而专门的时间序列方法达到最高峰值结果。人口学混杂因素很重要：呼吸信号对某些疾病提供独立诊断价值，但对其他疾病在年龄之外几乎没有增加信息。我们发布 S-OH 数据集、所有时间划分、评估协议和代码，以实现可重复研究并加速临床呼吸组学进展。

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for clinical documentation tasks despite limited evidence regarding their performance in health care settings compared with the current standard of care. items.abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.
items.zh_abstract: 机器学习的最新进展加速了生物医学预测，但在结构化生物医学数据上的评估仍然碎片化，尤其是对于具有高维、大样本量、缺失和类别不平衡的数据集。我们推出TabBioMed，一个大规模基准，包含94个经过整理的公开生物医学表格数据集，涵盖电子健康记录、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学和系统生物学。TabBioMed通过标准化、感知数据集的预处理和评估框架统一这些数据集，从而能够在分类、回归和多目标任务之间进行可复现比较。我们对23个模型进行了基准测试，涵盖经典基线、梯度提升树、神经表格架构和表格基础模型。基础模型在家族层面提供了最强的预测性能。然而，它们的增益依赖于数据情形（regime）：基于树的模型和调优的多层感知机仍极具竞争力，在推理时间或训练成本约束下常常占优。总体而言，TabBioMed表明生物医学表格学习强烈依赖情境，最佳模型选择取决于数据情形、任务类型和计算预算。我们发布TabBioMed，包含整理后的数据集和划分、预处理代码、基线和结果，为生物医学机器学习中的实际模型选择和未来方法开发提供可复现的基准，网址为 https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed。

items.abstract: Spatial omics has generated measurements at unprecedented scale, yet computational approaches remain largely confined to individual modalities and 2D representations. Here we assemble ImageOmicsNet-300M, a corpus of 300 million single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiles, including 24.9 million H&E-predicted virtual spatial transcriptomics profiles, and 4,623 H&E sections. Of these H&E sections, we generated 1,782 from aging mouse organs and serially sectioned human skin spanning five decades, with matched spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq. Building on this resource, we develop GenVinci, a multimodal tissue foundation model that reconstructs 3D tissue scenes from routine 2D histology. GenVinci predicts spatial gene expression from H&E with zero-shot generalization and maps senescence-associated states across 85.8 million cells, revealing cell-type-specific patterns and disease-associated remodeling. Integration with human genetics implicates suprabasal keratinocytes in atopic dermatitis and keratinocyte carcinomas, linked to higher and lower p16 and p21 expression, respectively. These findings establish GenVinci as a framework mapping senescence in 3D across scales.
items.zh_abstract: 空间组学已产生前所未有的规模测量，然而计算方法在很大程度上仍局限于单一模态和2D表示。在此，我们构建了ImageOmicsNet-300M，一个包含3亿个单细胞和空间转录组谱的语料库，包括2490万个由H&E预测的虚拟空间转录组谱和4623张H&E切片。在这些H&E切片中，我们生成了1782张来自衰老小鼠器官和跨越五十年的连续切片人类皮肤，并配有匹配的空间转录组学和snRNA-seq。基于这一资源，我们开发了GenVinci，一种多模态组织基础模型，可从常规2D组织学重建3D组织场景。GenVinci从H&E预测空间基因表达，具有零样本泛化能力，并在8580万个细胞中映射衰老相关状态，揭示细胞类型特异性模式和疾病相关重塑。与人类遗传学整合表明基底上层角质形成细胞（suprabasal keratinocytes）参与特应性皮炎和角质形成细胞癌，分别与较高和较低的p16和p21表达相关。这些发现确立GenVinci作为一个跨尺度在3D中映射衰老的框架。

items.abstract: Asthma affects over 260 million people worldwide, yet diagnosis remains dependent on spirometry and specialist assessment, limiting accessibility in primary care and low-resource settings. Vocal biomarkers offer a promising non-invasive alternative, but prior studies have largely focused on acoustic features without integrating clinical context. We present a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts framework for asthma identification that adaptively combines acoustic embeddings from sustained vowel phonation and reading passage tasks with structured clinical and demographic data. The model was evaluated on a matched cohort of 1218 self-reported asthma cases and healthy controls from the Colive Voice study. The multimodal model achieved an AUROC of 0.83 and Brier score of 0.18, outperforming unimodal approaches. Exploratory analysis of the gating mechanism in asthma cases showed that greater respiratory symptom burden was associated with increased weighting of reading-passage modality and reduced weighting of sustained-vowel phonation modality. These findings support the feasibility of voice-based identification of self-reported asthma; however, independent prospective validation remains necessary before clinical use.
items.zh_abstract: 哮喘影响全球超过 2.6 亿人，但诊断仍依赖肺量计检查和专科评估，限制了其在初级保健和低资源环境中的可及性。声音生物标志物提供了一种有前景的非侵入性替代方案，但既往研究主要集中于声学特征，未整合临床背景。我们提出一个用于哮喘识别的多模态专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）框架，该框架自适应地结合持续元音发声和朗读段落任务的声学嵌入与结构化临床和人口学数据。模型在来自 Colive Voice 研究的 1218 例自报哮喘病例和健康对照的匹配队列上进行了评估。多模态模型达到 AUROC 0.83 和 Brier 评分 0.18，优于单模态方法。对哮喘病例中门控机制的探索性分析显示，更大的呼吸症状负担与朗读段落模态权重增加及持续元音发声模态权重降低相关。这些发现支持基于声音识别自报哮喘的可行性；然而，在临床使用前仍需要独立的前瞻性验证。

items.abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
items.zh_abstract: 推动面向包容性医疗的医学AI需要跨多样医疗角色、任务和照护场景的评估，但基准覆盖仍不均衡。我们推出InclusionMed，一项面向包容性医疗的开放式医学AI评估倡议。InclusionMed Atlas将基准按三个医疗角色和三种AI能力组织。首个版本中，我们通过结构化审查和独立复现，从388个候选基准中选出了四个公开基准。加上我们的私有诊断推理基准InclusionMed-DxFiles，Atlas共包含五个基准，覆盖其九个角色—能力单元中的三个。我们在Atlas上评估了前沿大语言模型，并将结果汇总为InclusionMed Index，总体得分范围为17.5至49.1（满分100）。该Index还按医疗角色和AI能力报告得分，显示模型的排名会随所考虑的角色或能力而变化。使用任务级标签的基准内分析显示，Index中排名最高的十个模型在患者沟通上的得分均高于临床决策。Index得分相近的模型在估计推理成本上也存在显著差异。这些发现凸显了需要覆盖更多样化医疗需求的评估，以及针对具体情境选择模型。通过开放合作和社区贡献，InclusionMed力求确保全球多样化的医疗需求能够塑造医学AI进展的定义和衡量方式。

items.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
items.zh_abstract: 代理式人工智能（Agentic artificial intelligence）可自动化分析敏感临床数据，但当前代理依赖大语言模型（LLMs）。云端LLM会暴露患者数据。本地LLM会产生幻觉，并且工具调用中虚构的值会传播到后续每一步。在此，我们提出一种构建System 1代理的方法：这些本地代理在不生成文本的情况下调用工具。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的模式（schema）和请求转换为多项选择题，其选项来自请求和模式，然后由单次决策模型回答这些问题。在针对157个生物医学工具的1,952次请求中，最佳System 1代理在97.0%的请求中选择了正确工具或正确拒绝，显著领先于所有18种本地LLM代理设置（最佳为95.2%）。System 1代理填写了6,056个明确给出的参数值中的97.0%。没有任何System 1调用包含虚构内容，相比之下5.5-19.7%的LLM调用包含虚构内容。System 1 Agents框架作为开源软件可在 https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents 免费获取。

items.abstract: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved
items.zh_abstract: 高分辨率脑MRI对于神经影像学评估很重要，但常规临床方案往往依赖快速、各向异性的2D采集，尤其是在资源受限环境中。这些采集可能在方向、对齐和解剖覆盖范围上有所不同，导致图像堆栈部分重叠。现有的基于学习的超分辨率方法通常依赖单一的、约束不足的输入，或依赖具有理想化采集几何结构的固定多堆栈配置。我们提出MS-HVED，一种序列无关的框架，用于灵活的多堆栈脑MRI超分辨率。可用的轴位、冠状位和矢状位堆栈被独立编码为多尺度高斯后验，并使用视野感知的高斯乘积（Product-of-Gaussians）公式进行融合，该公式限制无支撑区域的贡献。物理信息引导的域随机化模拟异质性临床采集条件，包括倾斜、部分覆盖和成像伪影。MS-HVED在合成基准上实现了有竞争力或更优的重建保真度，并相对于低分辨率输入改善了下游组织分割。为评估超出训练队列的泛化能力，我们在来自尼日利亚队列的30例常规脑MRI检查上进行了外部临床验证，该队列代表医学影像研究中代表性不足的人群。这些检查构成了涉及44例真实病例和7名专家神经放射科医生的盲法读者研究的最大组成部分。在尼日利亚队列中，MS-HVED在210次配对评估中的187次被优先选择优于监督基线，评价指标为整体图像质量。在所有临床队列中，MS-HVED在使用所有可用输入时获得更高的整体质量评分（5.93 vs. 4.49，p<.001），当省略轴位或冠状位输入时，这种偏好仍然存在（p<.001）。代码见github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

items.title: Effect of Data Preprocessing Decisions on Sepsis-3 Labels in MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD: A Sensitivity Analysis
items.zh_title: 预处理决策对 MIMIC-III 与 eICU 中 Sepsis-3 标签的影响
items.summary: medRxiv 预印本在固定队列上逐一改变 51 种预处理设置，检验仅预处理差异能否解释文献中脓毒症检出率的巨大跨度。
key_points: 固定队列：MIMIC-III 13,388 例、eICU 94,782 例首住 ICU

items.abstract: Objective: Published Sepsis-3 detection rates range from 3.4 % to 65.2 % in MIMIC-III and from 9.8 % to 47.9 % in eICU-CRD. We tested whether data preprocessing decisions alone produce differences of this magnitude when data, cohort and sepsis definition are held fixed. Materials and Methods: Using the MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD databases we developed and applied a configurable pipeline (medalabel) that stepwise maps the databases into the OMOP Common Data Model, standardizes and cleans the data, and preprocesses them to compute Sepsis-3 labels. Each setting of the preprocessing represents one decision of published Sepsis-3 implementations, and settings can be freely combined. On fixed cohorts of first ICU stays (13,388 in MIMIC-III, 94,782 in eICU-CRD), we changed one setting of a reference configuration at a time (51 variants in five preprocessing domains) and compared detection rates and septic stays (Jaccard index) with the reference. We approximately reconstructed six published pipelines and combined the settings with the largest effects in pairs to test whether their effects add up. The time a value is measured can differ from the time it is documented and thus available for automated analysis. Beyond the usual retrospective view based on measurement time, the pipeline optionally combines both time points to simulate a real-time system. Results: The reference configuration labelled 31.5 % of ICU stays in MIMIC-III and 8.2 % in eICU-CRD as septic. Changing a single setting resulted in sepsis detection rates of 15.3-58.6 % in MIMIC-III and 4.6-17.2 % in eICU-CRD. The largest shifts from the reference, all in the same direction in both databases, came from the SOFA baseline, up to +27.1 percentage points (pp) in MIMIC-III and +9.0 pp in eICU-CRD, from disabling imputation (-16.3 and -2.5 pp), the temporal window (+12.6 and +5.3 pp) and aggregation (-10.1 and -0.8 pp); clinician-validated parameter sets had little effect (-4.8 and -1.1 pp). Even variants that changed the rate by less than 2 pp labelled partly different patients, with Jaccard indices as low as 0.67 in MIMIC-III and 0.56 in eICU-CRD (1 = identical septic stays). Reconstructions deviated from the published rates by 2-10 pp. Two settings applied together deviated from the sum of their single effects by 0.9-11.8 pp in MIMIC-III and by up to 4.9 pp in eICU-CRD. Simulating a real-time system lowered the MIMIC-III rate by 5.0 pp and delayed the label in 45 % of the stays that remained septic. Discus
items.zh_abstract: 【目的】已发表的Sepsis-3检出率在MIMIC-III中范围为3.4%至65.2%，在eICU-CRD中范围为9.8%至47.9%。我们在数据、队列和脓毒症定义保持不变的情况下，检验了仅数据预处理决策是否会产生如此幅度的差异。【材料与方法】使用MIMIC-III和eICU-CRD数据库，我们开发并应用了一个可配置流程（medalabel），该流程逐步将数据库映射到OMOP Common Data Model，标准化和清理数据，并对其进行预处理以计算Sepsis-3标签。预处理的每个设置代表已发表Sepsis-3实现的一项决策，且设置可自由组合。在固定的首次ICU住院队列中（MIMIC-III中13,388例，eICU-CRD中94,782例），我们每次改变参考配置的一个设置（五个预处理域中的51个变体），并将检出率和脓毒症住院（Jaccard指数）与参考配置进行比较。我们近似重建了六个已发表的流程，并将效应最大的设置成对组合，以检验其效应是否相加。一个数值被测量的时间可能不同于其被记录、从而可用于自动化分析的时间。除了基于测量时间的常规回顾性视图外，该流程还可选择合并这两个时间点，以模拟实时系统。【结果】参考配置将MIMIC-III中31.5%的ICU住院和eICU-CRD中8.2%的ICU住院标记为脓毒症。改变单一设置导致MIMIC-III中脓毒症检出率为15.3-58.6%，eICU-CRD中为4.6-17.2%。相对于参考配置的最大偏移（在两个数据库中方向均相同）来自SOFA基线，在MIMIC-III中高达+27.1个百分点（pp），在eICU-CRD中为+9.0 pp；来自禁用插补（-16.3和-2.5 pp）、时间窗（+12.6和+5.3 pp）和聚合（-10.1和-0.8 pp）；临床医生验证的参数集影响很小（-4.8和-1.1 pp）。即使是将检出率改变不足2 pp的变体，也标记了部分不同的患者，MIMIC-III中Jaccard指数低至0.67，eICU-CRD中低至0.56（1 = 完全相同的脓毒症住院）。重建结果与已发表检出率相差2-10 pp。两个设置共同应用时，其偏离各自单一效应之和的程度在MIMIC-III中为0.9-11.8 pp，在eICU-CRD中高达4.9 pp。模拟实时系统使MIMIC-III的检出率降低5.0 pp，并使45%的仍为脓毒症的住院标签延迟。Discus

items.abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a calibrated discharge model of 30-day within-system readmission in Medicare-insured adults, and to quantify how a future-information leak and outcome artifacts distorted performance, timing, and subgroup conclusions. Materials and Methods: Retrospective study of 236,906 Medicare-insured MIMIC-IV v3.1 admissions (87,750 patients; prevalence 21.4%). Predictors were audited for discharge-time availability; history features were tested for future information and recomputed from raw timestamps. A consensus gradient-boosted (XGBoost) model was selected inside patient-grouped folds; CIs used patient-cluster bootstrap. Results: A feature documented as a prior 180-day length-of-stay trend used each patient's whole record, including later admissions; removing it and two derived terms lowered test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from 0.774 to 0.706. The corrected procedure reached an out-of-fold AUROC of 0.7057 (95% CI 0.7016 to 0.7102; primary); the 44-feature model scored 0.7056 on the historically exposed test partition (calibration slope 0.99), above reconstructed LACE and HOSPITAL (both P<.001). A day-1 discrimination peak largely reflected 2,368 probable administrative continuations within 1 hour of discharge; merging these into the preceding stay gave test AUROC 0.698 (0.702 after refitting). The White minus Black AUROC difference was 0.003 (95% CI -0.018 to 0.024); specificity was lower for Black patients (0.61 vs 0.69). Discussion: Documentation audits and patient-grouped validation missed a leak that inflated discrimination and created spurious subgroup and calendar-period differences; simple empirical checks found it. Conclusion: Empirical leakage checks should accompany availability audits. The corrected model is calibrated, moderately discriminating, and needs external validation before clinical use.

【目的】开发并在内部验证一个校准的30天系统内再入院出院模型，用于参加 Medicare 保险的成人，并量化未来信息泄漏和结局伪差如何扭曲性能、时间及亚组结论。
【材料与方法】对236,906条 MIMIC-IV v3.1 中参加 Medicare 保险的住院记录（87,750名患者；患病率21.4%）进行回顾性研究。对预测变量进行出院时可用性审计；对病史特征检验未来信息，并从原始时间戳重新计算。在按患者分组的折内选择共识梯度提升（XGBoost）模型；置信区间使用患者簇自助法。
【结果】一个被记录为先前的180天住院时长趋势的特征使用了每位患者的整个记录，包括后续住院；移除该特征和两个派生项后，测试集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）从0.774降至0.706。校正后的流程达到折外 AUROC 0.7057（95% CI 0.7016至0.7102；主要结果）；44特征模型在历史暴露的测试分区上得分为0.7056（校准斜率0.99），高于重建的 LACE 和 HOSPITAL（均 P<.001）。第1天区分度峰值在很大程度上反映了出院1小时内2,368例可能的行政性连续住院；将这些合并到前一次住院后，测试 AUROC 为0.698（重新拟合后为0.702）。白人减黑人的 AUROC 差异为0.003（95% CI -0.018至0.024）；黑人患者的特异度较低（0.61 对 0.69）。
【讨论】记录审计和按患者分组验证漏掉了一个泄漏，该泄漏抬高了区分度并产生了虚假的亚组和日历时期差异；简单的经验性检查发现了它。
【结论】经验性泄漏检查应与可用性审计同时进行。校正后的模型已校准、具有中等区分度，在临床使用前需要外部验证。

items.abstract: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.
items.zh_abstract: 患者信息可以指导电子健康记录（EHR）生成，但其数量如何塑造预测效用和披露风险仍鲜有刻画。在此，我们提出 EHRDiB，它通过区分原始缺失与保留不提供的输入，并将共享多模态表示与证据条件化的潜在扩散桥相结合，统一了就诊完成和合成。我们在 MIMIC-IV 以及数值型和离散化 Duke Health 表示上，将 EHRDiB 与三种补全方法和八种合成方法进行了比较。评估涵盖两项任务的下游预测效用、生成多样性和分布保真度，以及合成任务的披露风险。在八项补全比较中的七项中，EHRDiB 相对于真实数据训练的分类器取得了最小的效用差距。在合成中，相对于最佳比较方法，十个 MIMIC-IV 主要诊断目标的 AUPRC 差距缩小了 45.2%，数值型 Duke Health 数据的 AUPRC 差距缩小了 53.3%。采用校准阈值化的合成在全部三个数据集上产生了最低的边缘分布误差，两种输出规则的 Coverage 均高于 0.95。在 MIMIC-IV 合成的十二个证据比例区间中，随着平均目标证据比例从 0.20 升至 0.50，成员推断 AUROC 从 0.516 增至 0.598；相对于最低证据配置，效用差距缩小，但并未单调下降。我们的研究为 EHR 生成提供了一个统一框架和实证基础，同时考虑其对临床分析的效用及其信息披露风险。

items.abstract: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect the factors that went into the decision. Here, we present Decision2Care, a decision agent that works up the acutely ill patient without producing any text. A decision model assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action, and fixed rules carry out the most probable one. We evaluated Decision2Care on the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases. Decision2Care reached a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5%, compared with 86.1% for the MIRA-v2 agent, and required a median of 2.2 s per work-up, compared with 92-100 s. Each work-up tracked which options Decision2Care was considering at each step. In 10 of the 12 diseases, the differential diagnosis changed most at the test on which the guideline bases the diagnosis. Where Decision2Care was most confident after a single work-up, all but four of its diagnoses were correct (98.5%). We traced each of these four errors back to a single imaging report. Three of them were corrected when that report was removed. The same kind of decision was used to select the treatments, and Decision2Care's drug orders were judged guideline-adherent more often than MIRA-v2's. In emergency patients, its prediction of death was comparable to that of three intensivists on the same cases. In five of the eight intensive care cohorts, it exceeded the best of the three 24-h severity scores within 2-6 h of records. Our results show that decision agents can carry out clinical work-ups while recording the options, probabilities, and execution rules behind each action for audit.
items.zh_abstract: 临床医生在审阅诊断检查流程时会询问每一步考虑了哪些可能，以及评估为何发生变化。由自由文本驱动的智能体可以达到医生水平的诊断准确率，但其书面推理并不总能反映决策中考虑的因素。在此，我们提出 Decision2Care，一种决策智能体，可在不生成任何文本的情况下对急性病患者进行诊断检查。一个决策模型为每个允许的电子健康记录（EHR）操作分配概率，固定规则执行概率最高的操作。我们在涵盖 12 种疾病的 546 例急诊入院记录上评估了 Decision2Care。Decision2Care 达到 86.5% 的诊断准确率，而 MIRA-v2 智能体为 86.1%；每次诊断检查所需时间中位数为 2.2 秒，而后者为 92-100 秒。每次诊断检查都追踪了 Decision2Care 在每一步正在考虑哪些选项。在 12 种疾病中的 10 种中，鉴别诊断变化最大的是指南据以作出诊断的检查。在 Decision2Care 单次诊断检查后最有信心的病例中，其诊断除四例外均正确（98.5%）。我们将这四例错误中的每一例都追溯至一份影像报告。当移除该报告后，其中三例得到纠正。同类决策被用于选择治疗，且 Decision2Care 的用药医嘱被判定为符合指南的频率高于 MIRA-v2。在急诊患者中，其对死亡的预测与三位重症监护医师对相同病例的预测相当。在八个重症监护队列中的五个中，其在记录后 2-6 小时内超过了三种 24 小时严重程度评分中的最佳者。我们的结果表明，决策智能体能够执行临床诊断检查，同时记录每项操作背后的选项、概率和执行规则以供审计。

items.abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering routine care through documentation tools, decision support, and hospital operations. The central question is whether these systems improve clinical work and patient care once embedded in routine workflows, not only whether they perform well on test data. This targeted narrative review follows AI from voice dictation and ambient documentation to operating room (OR) organization, using hysteroscopy as a clinical exemplar of the transition from technical performance to clinical utility. Evidence identified through targeted searches completed on 6 September 2026 was appraised with a framework that distinguishes image-level from patient-level results, internal from independent validation, and discrimination from clinical utility. Randomized trials and multisite observational data show modest, product-dependent benefits of clinician-reviewed ambient documentation; inaccuracies persist. Evidence for patient-message drafting derives from ratings of responses to public-forum questions and supports only bounded, supervised feasibility testing. In hysteroscopy, selected models discriminate well in narrowly defined tasks, but most studies are retrospective, image-level, or internally validated, and patient-level errors in high-risk categories are seldom reported. Reported gains in OR scheduling come largely from simulation. Safe implementation requires a defined clinical need, baseline measurement, subgroup-aware local validation, accountable review, and predefined criteria for expansion or withdrawal.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 人工智能（AI）正通过文档工具、决策支持和医院运营进入常规诊疗。核心问题在于这些系统在嵌入常规工作流程后是否能改善临床工作和患者照护，而不仅仅是它们在测试数据上表现良好。本针对性叙述性综述追踪AI从语音听写和环境文档到手术室（OR）组织的应用，并以宫腔镜作为从技术性能向临床效用转变的临床范例。通过截至2026年9月6日完成的针对性检索所识别的证据，采用一个区分图像层面与患者层面结果、内部验证与独立验证、区分能力与临床效用的框架进行评价。随机试验和多中心观察数据显示，由临床医生审核的环境文档具有适度且因产品而异的获益；不准确之处仍然存在。患者信息起草的证据来源于对公共论坛问题回答的评分，仅支持有范围限制的、受监督的可行性测试。在宫腔镜中，选定模型在狭义定义任务中区分能力良好，但大多数研究为回顾性、图像层面或内部验证，且高风险类别中的患者层面错误很少被报告。所报告的手术室排程改善主要来自模拟。安全实施需要有明确的临床需求、基线测量、考虑亚组的本地验证、可问责的审核，以及预先设定的扩展或退出标准。

items.abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Pulmonary diseases currently pose significant threats to global health, spanning common chronic conditions including lung cancer, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and asthma, as well as infectious and inflammatory diseases like tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease (ILD), and COVID-19. Therefore, accurate diagnosis, effective therapeutic strategies, and reliable assessment of prognosis for pulmonary diseases are essential for improving patient outcomes and safeguarding public health. Despite the increasing availability of medical imaging and pathological data owing to improvements in detection technologies, what is becoming increasingly evident are the limitations of conventional diagnosis, which relies solely on clinicians' subjective judgment based on imaging, pulmonary function, pathology, and clinical experience. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology, especially machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), has made significant progress in areas such as image recognition and model construction. Numerous studies have demonstrated the widespread application of AI in the screening and diagnosis of lung diseases, the optimization of treatment strategies, and prognosis assessment, revealing its remarkable ability to process and interpret complex clinical data. Although concerns persist regarding data quality, the "black box" nature of algorithms, clinical practice, and the regulatory landscape, the application of AI in lung disease research and clinical care is more and more promising. In this review, we summarize the latest advances of AI in the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary diseases, analyze the challenges and limitations of current AI technologies ranging from data and algorithms to clinical translation, and highlight directions for future research.
items.zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 肺部疾病目前对全球健康构成重大威胁，涵盖常见慢性疾病，包括肺癌、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和哮喘，以及感染性和炎症性疾病，如结核病、间质性肺疾病（ILD）和COVID-19。因此，对肺部疾病进行准确诊断、采取有效治疗策略以及可靠评估预后，对于改善患者结局和保障公共卫生至关重要。尽管随着检测技术的进步，医学影像和病理数据的可及性日益增加，但越来越明显的是，仅依赖临床医生基于影像、肺功能、病理和临床经验的主观判断的传统诊断存在局限性。近年来，人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），在图像识别和模型构建等领域取得了显著进展。大量研究已证明AI在肺部疾病筛查和诊断、治疗策略优化以及预后评估中的广泛应用，显示出其处理和解释复杂临床数据的显著能力。尽管在数据质量、算法的“黑箱”性质、临床实践和监管环境方面仍存在担忧，但AI在肺部疾病研究和临床照护中的应用正日益具有前景。在本综述中，我们总结了AI在肺部疾病诊断和治疗中的最新进展，分析了当前AI技术从数据和算法到临床转化方面的挑战和局限性，并强调了未来研究方向。

items.abstract: AbstractAI is often framed as a threat to medical education owing to concerns it may diminish the cognitive struggle through which trainees traditionally develop clinical judgment - a legitimate but incomplete concern. Medicine has never been defined by unaided human cognition; it has been defined by the obligation to use the best available tools in the service of patients. As AI systems increasingly extend not only clinicians' perception, but also their reasoning, medical mastery may shift from memorization and independent synthesis toward the orchestration, supervision, and calibrated deference to intelligent systems. The task for medical education is therefore not to preserve cognitive struggle for its own sake, but to refocus it from recalling facts to interrogating machine reasoning, detecting failure modes, and knowing when human intervention improves care versus when it merely interrupts a better system.
items.zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）常被框定为对医学教育的威胁，因为人们担心它可能会削弱受训者传统上借以发展临床判断力的认知挣扎——这一担忧合理但并不全面。医学从来不是由无辅助的人类认知来定义的；它是由为患者服务而使用最佳可用工具的义务来定义的。随着 AI 系统日益不仅扩展临床医生的感知，也扩展其推理能力，医学精通可能会从记忆与独立综合转向对智能系统的编排、监督和有校准的遵从。因此，医学教育的任务不是为认知挣扎本身而保留它，而是将其重心从回忆事实转向质询机器推理、检测失败模式，以及知道何时人类干预能改善照护、何时它只是打断了一个更好的系统。

items.abstract: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
items.zh_abstract: 常规 X 射线模态如锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）针对高对比度矿化组织进行优化，使软组织异常埋没在光子噪声之下并低于人类视觉感知。因此，检测非钙化病变需要二次磁共振成像（MRI）。我们证明，软组织病变的亚视觉放射学特征在物理上保留于常规 CBCT 扫描中，并且即使在配对数据极度稀缺的情况下，也可使用有针对性的、物理引导的深度学习流程提取用于机会性筛查。以颞下颌关节（TMJ）作为模型系统（N = 212 对 CBCT-MRI 关节），我们通过两阶段框架解决高容量 3D 网络的严重过拟合。首先，我们采用冻结的全网格 3D 掩码自编码器（BertsWin），通过 GradientConductor（GCond）优化器和解剖感知目标（PhysLoss）在 6,550 个未标注 CBCT 体积上预训练，该目标将梯度流重定向到 [-300, 300] HU 软组织窗。其次，髁突顶点的自动定位驱动确定性 3D 裁剪，消除 81% 的背景骨性方差。通过患者隔离的 3x10 折分层交叉验证方案评估，MRI 证实的滑膜积液的统计稳健亚视觉信号（ROC AUC = 0.793）仅从使用 PhysLoss 和 GCond 方案预训练的表征中出现。关键的是，只有这种设置能捕获真正的 3D 解剖手性（p < 0.001）和高患者内结构一致性（0.791）而非患者间噪声；相反，使用标准 L2 损失或未掩码方差分解（MVC）预训练的相同架构退化为随机猜测。这些发现建立了一个可推广的范式，将常规低对比度放射学扫描重新用于隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查工具。

items.abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] Craniosynostosis, the premature fusion of cranial sutures, can cause abnormal skull shapes, neurological issues and aesthetic concerns. Surgical correction is standard, but planning is complex and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers the potential to enhance diagnosis, optimise planning and predict postoperative outcomes. A scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines identified 11 studies involving paediatric patients with craniosynostosis. AI methods included unsupervised machine learning, convolutional neural networks, finite element models and variational autoencoders. Applications encompassed cranial severity scoring, phenotype classification, preoperative surgical simulation, intraoperative guidance and outcome prediction. AI-derived metrics correlated strongly with expert assessments, facilitated patient-specific planning and predicted postoperative aesthetics. AI is a transformative adjunct in craniosynostosis surgery. Clinically, it improves diagnostic accuracy, supports personalised surgical planning and guides intraoperative decision-making. Some studies show AI can contribute to better functional and aesthetic outcomes, showing great promise in the paediatric surgical field. Although AI does not replace clinical expertise, it enhances precision and reproducibility. Future research should prioritise prospective validation, integration into surgical workflows and development of interpretable, surgeon-friendly AI tools to maximise clinical benefit.
items.zh_abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] 颅缝早闭是指颅缝过早融合，可导致颅骨形状异常、神经学问题和美学顾虑。手术矫正是标准治疗，但规划复杂且依赖操作者。人工智能（AI）有望增强诊断、优化规划并预测术后结局。一项遵循PRISMA-ScR指南的范围综述识别出11项涉及颅缝早闭儿科患者的研究。AI方法包括无监督机器学习、卷积神经网络、有限元模型和变分自编码器。应用涵盖颅骨严重程度评分、表型分类、术前手术模拟、术中引导和结局预测。AI得出的指标与专家评估高度相关，促进了患者特异性规划，并预测了术后美学。AI是颅缝早闭手术中的变革性辅助手段。在临床上，它提高诊断准确性、支持个性化手术规划并指导术中决策。一些研究显示AI可有助于改善功能和美学结局，在儿科外科领域展现出巨大前景。尽管AI不能替代临床专业知识，但它增强了精确性和可重复性。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性验证、整合到手术工作流程中，并开发可解释、外科医生友好的AI工具，以最大化临床获益。

items.abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation; conditions: Tuberculosis Infection, Latent, Tuberculosis Prevention; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1804; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The Artificial Intelligence Assisted Innovative Low-cost Skin Testing Model to Accelerate Person-centered TB Prevention Services in Tanzania, Mozambique and Uganda (TEST4TPT) project will evaluate a person-centered approach to improve access to tuberculosis infection (TBI) testing and linkage to tuberculosis preventive treatment (TPT) in Mozambique, Tanzania, and Uganda. The project will generate evidence on the feasibility, acceptability, clinical utility, diagnostic and operational performance, and implementation of a novel point-of-care TBI testing approach, including home- or community-based testing and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted reading. By bringing testing closer to people at increased risk of tuberculosis (TB), TEST4TPT aims to reduce barriers to care, support timely TPT initiation, and contribute to improved completion of preventive treatment. The overall goal of TEST4TPT is to evaluate an integrated, home-based approach to TBI testing using SIILTIBCY (an authorized diagnostic skin test used to detect TBI), community health worker (CHW)-facilitated support, and AI-assisted result reading, with the aim of improving initiation and completion of TPT among close contacts of people newly diagnosed with pulmonary TB disease.

items.abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chinese PLA General Hospital; conditions: Kidney (Renal Cell) Cancer, Ureteropelvic Junction Obstruction, Upper Urinary Tract Carcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1700; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate whether an artificial intelligence (AI) based software system can assist surgeons in identifying key anatomical structures during minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery. During these procedures, surgeons operate while viewing images from laparoscopic endoscope. Key anatomical structures, such as the kidney, renal artery and vein, ureter, renal pelvis, inferior vena cava, and left reproductive vein, as well as surgical targets such as tumors, may sometimes be difficult to distinguish because of bleeding, surgical smoke, tissue movement, changes in tissue appearance, or obstruction by surgical instruments. The study team has developed an AI-based image recognition system that analyzes surgical video in real time and identifies and outlines relevant anatomical structures on the screen during surgery. The study has two main goals (primary endpoints): 1. To evaluate how accurately the AI system can identify and delineate key anatomical structures in surgical videos collected from different hospitals, surgeons, surgical procedures, and imaging systems. 2. To evaluate the real-time performance and technical reliability of the AI system in the operating room, including processing latency, frame rate, system failure rate, and the proportion of time during surgery in which AI-generated results are successfully displayed. The study will include adults aged 18 years or older who undergo one of five types of minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery: partial nephrectomy, radical nephrectomy, radical nephroureterectomy, inferior vena cava tumor thrombectomy, or pyeloplasty. The study will be conducted at 11 hospitals in China. In the first phase, surgical videos recorded between 2015 and 2025 will be used to develop, validate, and test the AI system. In the second phase, approximately 100 patients will be prospectively enrolled from internal centers, and the AI-generated anatomical recognition results will be displayed on a monitor during surgery. Overall, approximately 1,600 retrospective surgical cases and 100 prospective cases are planned for inclusion. The AI system is designed solely as an assistive tool for anatomical recognition. It does not make clinical decisions, provide autonomous surgical instructions, or control any surgical equipment. Surgeons remain fully responsible for all clinical and surgical decisions, and the AI display can be turned off at any time. All participants will receive standard clinical care. Parti
items.zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中国人民解放军总医院；疾病：肾脏（肾细胞）癌、肾盂输尿管连接部梗阻、上尿路癌；类型：OBSERVATIONAL（观察性）；入组：1700；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 本研究旨在评估基于人工智能（AI）的软件系统能否在微创上尿路手术中协助外科医生识别关键解剖结构。在这些手术中，外科医生通过观察腹腔镜内窥镜图像进行操作。关键解剖结构，如肾脏、肾动脉和肾静脉、输尿管、肾盂、下腔静脉和左生殖静脉，以及手术目标如肿瘤，有时可能因出血、手术烟雾、组织移动、组织外观变化或手术器械遮挡而难以区分。研究团队开发了一种基于AI的图像识别系统，可实时分析手术视频，并在手术过程中于屏幕上识别和勾勒相关解剖结构。本研究有两个主要目标（主要终点）：1. 评估AI系统在来自不同医院、外科医生、手术方式和成像系统采集的手术视频中识别和勾画关键解剖结构的准确性。2. 评估AI系统在手术室中的实时性能和技术可靠性，包括处理延迟、帧率、系统故障率，以及手术期间AI生成结果成功显示的时间比例。研究将纳入接受以下五类微创上尿路手术之一的18岁及以上成年人：肾部分切除术、根治性肾切除术、根治性肾输尿管切除术、下腔静脉癌栓取出术或肾盂成形术。本研究将在中国11家医院开展。第一阶段将使用2015年至2025年间记录的手术视频来开发、验证和测试AI系统。第二阶段将从内部中心前瞻性入组约100例患者，并在手术期间于监视器上显示AI生成的解剖识别结果。总体计划纳入约1,600例回顾性手术病例和100例前瞻性病例。AI系统仅设计为解剖识别的辅助工具。它不做出临床决策、不提供自主手术指令，也不控制任何手术设备。外科医生仍对所有临床和手术决策负全部责任，且AI显示可随时关闭。所有参与者将接受标准临床护理。Parti

items.abstract: AO_SCPLOWBSTRACTC_SCPLOWClinical biosignals such as ECG, PPG, and EEG are increasingly acquired as hours-long streams from bedside monitors and wearables, yet existing analysis pipelines almost universally operate on isolated short windows of around 10 seconds and cannot process the long, irregular, frequently interrupted signals. We introduce BioLT, a streaming decoder-only framework for long-context biosignal modeling that turns any window-level feature extractor or pretrained biosignal foundation model into a streaming model. BioLT combines (i) a discontinuity-aware encoding that exposes the inter-window elapsed time as an explicit input channel, so that the decoder can learn to model these gaps as clinically meaningful information, and (ii) a fixed-size compressed memory bank supervised with cumulative summary statistics, which keeps both training and inference linear in the recording length while preserving long-range context. We evaluate on CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT for arrhythmia, sepsis, and seizure detection and for forecasting up to 20 minutes ahead, using domain features and embeddings from six biosignal foundation models. Across 21 dataset-feature settings, BioLT achieves the highest detection AUROC in 15 and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13 settings, and shows consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art snapshot foundation-model embeddings. These highlight the importance of modeling how streaming biosignal representations evolve over time, beyond improving window-level representations alone.
items.zh_abstract: 临床生物信号（如 ECG、PPG 和 EEG）越来越多地以长达数小时的流形式从床旁监护仪和可穿戴设备中采集，但现有分析流程几乎普遍只处理约 10 秒的孤立短窗口，无法处理长时、不规则且频繁中断的信号。我们提出 BioLT，一种用于长上下文生物信号建模的流式仅解码器框架，可将任意窗口级特征提取器或预训练生物信号基础模型转换为流式模型。BioLT 结合了：(i) 不连续性感知编码，将窗口间经过时间作为显式输入通道暴露出来，使解码器能够学习将这些间隔建模为具有临床意义的信息；(ii) 一个固定大小的压缩记忆库，由累积汇总统计量监督，使训练和推理在记录长度上保持线性，同时保留长程上下文。我们在 CPSC-2021、VitalDB、MC-MED 和 CHB-MIT 上评估心律失常、脓毒症和癫痫发作检测以及最长提前 20 分钟的预测，使用领域特征和来自六个生物信号基础模型的嵌入。在 21 个数据集-特征设置中，BioLT 在 15 个设置中取得最高检测 AUROC，在 13 个设置中取得最高 20 分钟预测 AUROC，并相较于最先进的快照基础模型嵌入表现出持续的性能提升。这些结果突显了建模流式生物信号表示如何随时间演变的重要性，而不仅仅是改进窗口级表示。
